$comment: Optional health tests after the movement trial. Scoring norms live in src/lib/science/tests.ts (see references/norms.md).
intro: Optional extras: 3 quick health checks give me a fuller picture of your heart and flexibility. Skip any you can't do now.

tests.title: Resting heart rate
steps: Sit quietly for 5 minutes (mornings are best).
Find your pulse at your wrist or neck.
Count beats for 60 seconds, or read your watch.

tests.title: 3-minute step test
steps: Start the metronome: up, up, down, down on each beat.
Sit down right away and count your pulse for 60 seconds.
tests.safety: Skip if you have knee or balance problems or a health flag you haven't cleared with a doctor.

tests.title: Sit and reach
steps: Sit with legs straight, feet against a wall.
Reach forward slowly with stacked hands and hold 2 seconds.
Measure how far past your toes you reach (negative if short). Best of 3.

tests.title: Single-leg balance
steps: Stand on one leg, hands on hips, eyes open.
Time until you touch down (max 45 s).
Test both legs and enter the weaker one.

tests.title: Waist measurement
steps: Measure around your belly button, snug but not tight.
